summary.text: Natalie Barnes is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 54B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Christopher Kartschoke (D) for a seat with no incumbent.
She won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary over Chris Steward, 66.6 percent to 33.4 percent.

paragraphs.text: Natalie Barnes sought the Republican nomination for Minnesota State Senate District 54 in 2022, when incumbent Eric Pratt defeated her in the primary.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom, nurse, business owner and Minnesotan.
She listed her campaign messages then as taxes and inflation, school transparency and school choice, and protection of individual choices.
